notes.title: People Cu3ed Christmas Update
notes.content:
Get ready to squeeze your baubles! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33334862/77c517856d3a5ab54309156e6b2c2f41e533c64e.png

We've released version 1.1 of People Cu3ed, and to help you enjoy this magical time of year, we've also included a free re-skin of the game that has a distinctly 'Christmassy' feel! We're also putting People Cu3ed on Sale to celebrate (beginning on the 8th December) - hurrah!

On opening the game, on the main menu you should see a prominent button to the side of the previous options inviting you to 'Activate Christmas Mode' - we invite you to push it, and let the snow covered fun begin!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33334862/9067dd9e59c01203251be8fc04105ede7290910c.jpg

In the update, as well as the optional re-skin, we've included some lighting and performance updates, including dramatically shrinking the amount of space the game takes up on your computer (but not the amount of time it will take you to complete it!) We've also fixed a couple of minor bugs we found as well - if you do spot any we've missed, as always - let us know - and we'll be on them ASAP with the bug spray!

We hope you enjoy People Cu3ed and it's new Christmas mode, and as always: Happy Gaming!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33334862/a301e2b111c6a0de82fee3943c8a60e0cab19b2c.png

- Whitway Studios

notes.title: 1.03 Update
notes.content:
Hi All,
 
Update 1.03 is now live. Changes in this update:

 ·         Performance improvements on lower end systems.

·         Handling improvements on most levels.

·         Bug fixes:

o   Stopping the cu3es escaping in the corners of the levels.
o   Eliminating the audio spikes on finishing some levels (on some set-ups).
o   Removal of the bug where there is a remote chance of dying and finishing a level at the same time on some levels.

Keep talking with us – we love to hear from you – and of course:

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Update 1.02 - People Cu3ed
notes.content:
Hello All,

Just a small update this evening, as part of our continuing efforts to make People Cu3ed as much fun as it can be!

- Improved collision detection on levels 19, 4, 13 and 14.
- Re-worked audio levels on level 13.
- Altered difficulty on level 13 based on user feedback.
- Fixed a bug on level 13 where by a player could complete the level having gone back out to the chasm to rescue a block and get stuck outside themselves.

As always - enjoy - come speak to our small but friendly team - and:

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Update 1.01 - People Cu3ed
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

Whilst Steam's issues continue (help us Valve - you're our only hope!) and you still can't buy People Cu3ed (along with many other titles), we've still been busy making the game better.

We've just pushed out version 1.01 - which includes the following fixes:

- Certain set-ups were experiencing audio issues on level 2 and 8. Our update will now bring volume back into the 'normal' range (Becky no longer streams in your ear when you jump on her!)
- Some collisions weren't detected properly on levels 8 and 23 - this has now been fixed.

Keep talking to us - we love to interact, and if you spot an area that is less than perfect - tell us - we want to make sure you enjoy playing People Cu3ed as much as we did making it.

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Free Demo Released!
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that the free demo for People Cu3ed is now available to download and play on Steam.

What do you get in a free demo these days?

- 5 of the 40 levels in the finished game
- the full tutorial (or shortened version - up to you!)
- The introduction to the story in People Cu3ed
- The chance to interact with us lovely people and let us know what you think

That last one is important. This game has been built from the ground up based on feedback from our testers and general testing with 'random people'. We want to continue that as we progress towards out November 2nd full release.

Please, please, please get in touch with us and let us know what you think. We want your feedback, and we want to talk, so either through the plethora of social media we are on (just search for Whitway Studios) or if you are feeling traditional - via email (info@whitwaystudios.com) - feel free to get in touch and let us know about your experiences with the demo.

Cheers!

notes.title: Demo Update + Oculus Performance
notes.content:
We've just put an updated version of the demo up on Steam, for all of those with early access to the demo itself. Provided there are no last minute issues - this will be the version we go live to the public with on Friday!

A quick note on Oculus Rift performance. Whilst a lot of general improvements have been included in the updated demo that will make the game run more smoothly across a lot of low end systems, the major focus was to improve Oculus Rift performance.

Having investigated the issue, performance only suffers when multiple monitors are used in addition to the main one, and the headset itself. It appears that with the conversion OpenVR is doing to move the SteamVR game across to the Rift, the HMD attempts to sync it's rendering with the other monitors and this causes artifacts to be displayed that aren't present with either the Vive or Windows MR system (with these systems we've been able to render 3 monitors including a 32 inch 4k screen as well!)

Therefore we are strongly recommending that during your VR playtime, if you run an Oculus Rift, you disconnect your extra monitors - and only use the traditional one external screen. We've set this to display our 'Social Strategic View', for your audience to enjoy!

If you have any questions or comments, please get in touch with us directly :) we are friendly!

Have fun!
